sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Huntsman Path - Eraser is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Come in, have a seat. I've got a special job for you. You know the military base south of the customs terminal? There's a man holed up there, a former Marine. Even before everything fell apart in Tarkov, he had already turned to crime. His people had connections everywhere: law enforcement, customs, the whole lot. When it all went to hell, the gang fell apart, except for him... He gathered a circle of trusted men, fellow former soldiers, and dug in at the base. Now he's selling off military stockpiles on the black market and doesn't take kindly to visitors. Worse still, I've heard he's smuggling goods beyond the region. That has to end. Rid Tarkov of him and his crew. And one more thing: bring me a few trophies from them."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and neutralize Glukhar
- Hand over 2 found in raid Glukhar's guards' helmets
  - (Optional) Search Glukhar's guards and collect their helmets of Class 4 or higher

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Welcome back, hunter. So you dealt with the bandits? I can only imagine how much trouble they gave you. You did well. Excellent work."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you have to kill Glukhar and hand over 2 found in raid helmets of class 4 or higher. You can hand over any of the following helmets:
- Altyn assault helmet (Olive Drab)
- Vulkan-5 LShZ-5 bulletproof helmet (Black)
- HighCom Striker ULACH IIIA helmet (Black)
- HighCom Striker ULACH IIIA helmet (Desert Tan)
- MSA Gallet TC 800 High Cut combat helmet (Black)
- Ops-Core FAST MT Super High Cut helmet (Black)
- BNTI LShZ-2DTM helmet (Black)
- Maska-1SCh bulletproof helmet (Olive Drab)
- MSA ACH TC-2002 MICH Series helmet (Olive Drab)
- 6B47 Ratnik-BSh helmet (EMR cover)
- NPP KlASS Tor-2 helmet (Olive Drab)
- NFM HJELM helmet (Hellhound Grey)
- ZSh-1-2M helmet (Black cover)
- ZSh-1-2M helmet (Olive Drab)
